### <span class="method-badge" data-method="GET">GET</span> `/nodes/{node}/apt/history`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).apt.history.$get()
```

List past APT transactions and their package changes, newest first.

Returns an array of `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `limit` | number |  | List at most this many transactions. — min 1 |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `package` | string |  | Only list transactions that changed this package. |
| `since` | number |  | Only list transactions that started at or after this Unix epoch. |
| `until` | number |  | Only list transactions that started at or before this Unix epoch. |

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="GET">GET</span> `/nodes/{node}/apt/installed-changelog`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).apt["installed-changelog"].$get()
```

Get the Debian changelog that an installed package ships, optionally limited to a version range.

Returns an array of `object`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | string | yes | Name of the installed package. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `since-version` | string |  | Only list the entries of versions later than this one. — ≤ 128 chars |
| `to-version` | string |  | Only list the entries of versions up to including this one, or only the newest entry if the changelog does not list this version. — ≤ 128 chars |

### <span class="method-badge" data-method="GET">GET</span> `/nodes/{node}/apt/termlog`

```ts
proxmox.nodes.$(node).apt.termlog.$get()
```

Get the terminal output of a past APT transaction.

Returns `string`.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Notes |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `format` | `plain` \| `styled` |  | Format of the output, 'styled' keeps bold, dim and the basic foreground colors as SGR escape sequences, each setting the complete style and none spanning a line break. — default `"plain"` |
| `node` | string | yes | The cluster node name. — format `pve-node` |
| `start-index` | number |  | Start index of the transaction, as listed in the APT history. — min 0, max 4294967295, default `0` |
| `start-time` | number | yes | Start time of the transaction, as listed in the APT history. |
